name: DuduDesk
title: 集中处理渠道来信，保留每次接待的上下文。
Handle channel messages with the conversation context in view.
lead: 面向日常接待的坐席，在同一工作区查看会话历史、发送回复并维护来访资料。支持浏览器访问，也可构建桌面端。
For support agents handling daily conversations: review history, reply and maintain visitor details in one workspace. Use a browser or build the desktop app.
features: 统一会话
Unified conversations
在授权范围内查看渠道会话，使用搜索与筛选定位需要处理的来信。
Review channel conversations within your scope and use search and filters to find messages.
三种接待布局
Three workspace layouts
专注、并排和卡片布局共享会话数据与草稿，按接待方式选择视图。
Focused, side-by-side and card layouts share conversation data and drafts.
消息与回复
Messages and replies
查看历史和实时来信，发送纯文本回复，并查看发送结果。
Read history and incoming messages, send plain-text replies and review send results.
共享来访资料
Shared visitor details
维护有权限员工之间共享的来访标签和内部备注。
Maintain visitor tags and internal notes shared with authorized staff.
消息阅读翻译
Message translation
逐条点击翻译或开启自动翻译，保留原文并选择自己的阅读语言，不改变发送正文。
Translate individual text messages or enable automatic translation. Keep the original text and choose a reading language without changing outbound messages.
AI 悬浮助手
Floating AI assistant
结合当前授权会话了解来意、拟写回复和润色草稿。助手跟随当前回复对象，建议由坐席采纳到草稿，核对后发送。
Summarize an authorized conversation, draft a reply or polish your writing. The assistant follows the current visitor. Agents review suggestions, adopt them into a draft and send when ready.
steps: 使用企业员工身份登录，读取当前用户组授权的会话范围。
Sign in as an organization employee to access conversations allowed by your groups.
选择会话、阅读历史并回复来信。
Choose a conversation, review its history and send a reply.
维护标签和内部备注，根据需要结束或继续接待。
Maintain tags and internal notes, then close or continue the conversation.
scope: 当前仅支持发送纯文本，暂不支持发送附件。接收非文本消息和读取媒体取决于渠道能力与凭据。
Outbound replies currently support plain text only. Incoming non-text messages and media retrieval depend on channel capabilities and credentials.

title: 用熟悉的语言阅读消息
Read messages in your language
description: 点击消息翻译，或在工作台设置中开启自动翻译。译文与原文同时显示，翻译服务由初始企业管理员在 Console 配置。
Translate a message on demand or enable automatic translation in workspace settings. Translations appear beside the original text. The initial administrator configures the service in Console.
alt: Desk 双向消息的原文、译文与阅读语言设置
Desk original messages, translations and reading language settings

title: 接待时，随时展开 AI 助手
Open an AI assistant alongside your conversations
description: 结合当前授权会话了解来意、拟写回复和润色草稿。助手跟随当前回复对象，建议由坐席采纳到草稿，核对后发送。
Summarize an authorized conversation, draft a reply or polish your writing. The assistant follows the current visitor. Agents review suggestions, adopt them into a draft and send when ready.
alt: Desk 悬浮 AI 助手为当前来访用户拟写回复，提供放入草稿操作
Desk floating AI assistant drafts a reply for the current visitor with an action to adopt it into the composer

name: DuduConsole
title: 配置团队与渠道，明确接待范围。
Configure staff, channels and conversation access.
lead: 面向企业管理员，集中维护员工、用户组和渠道账号。通过用户组组织接待范围，日常回复由坐席工作台完成。
For organization administrators managing staff, user groups and channel accounts. Groups define conversation access; agents reply in Desk.
features: 员工管理
Staff management
创建和维护员工账号、状态及相应权限，按管理员职责控制操作范围。
Create and maintain staff accounts, status and permissions within the administrator’s scope.
用户组
User groups
按团队组织成员，将渠道账号关联到对应接待组。
Organize team membership and associate channel accounts with the appropriate groups.
渠道账号
Channel accounts
按渠道要求配置接收与发送凭据，查看回调地址及配置缺项。
Configure receiving and sending credentials, review callback URLs and missing settings.
凭据保护
Credential protection
敏感凭据只写入，不在读取响应中返回秘密值。
Secret credentials are write-only and are not returned in read responses.
企业翻译服务
Organization translation services
初始企业管理员配置常规或模型翻译服务，测试连接并选择全企业默认服务，保存的凭据不回显。
The initial administrator configures conventional or model-based translation services, tests a connection and selects the organization default. Saved secrets are not returned.
AI 助手模型配置
Assistant model configuration
初始企业管理员在「AI 与翻译服务」中选择助手模型，可与阅读翻译使用不同服务。启用后，授权会话的近期文本、标签、内部备注和本次草稿会发送给所选模型。

The initial administrator selects an assistant model in AI and translation services, independently of reading translation. Once enabled, recent authorized messages, tags, internal notes and the current draft are sent to that model.
steps: 使用企业 ID 和管理员账号登录。
Sign in with your organization ID and administrator account.
配置员工与用户组，再为渠道账号分配接待组。
Set up staff and groups, then assign channel accounts to their support groups.
按平台要求完成授权、回调配置和真实收发验证。
Complete platform authorization, callback setup and real messaging validation.
scope: 初始企业管理员与普通管理员的管理范围不同。配置完整不代表平台授权有效；当前不提供内置 OAuth 授权向导、自动连通检测或渠道健康监控。

Initial and regular administrators have different management scopes. Complete settings do not establish valid platform authorization. A built-in OAuth wizard, automatic connectivity checks and channel health monitoring are not available.

title: 统一配置企业翻译服务
Configure translation for your team
description: 接入企业自己的常规翻译 API 或模型服务，填写地址与凭据后测试连接，再选择默认服务。坐席可单独设置阅读语言与自动翻译开关。实际可用范围以服务目录和连接测试为准。

Connect your own translation API or model service, enter its endpoint and credentials, test the connection and choose a default. Agents keep their own reading language and automatic translation preferences. Availability depends on the service directory and a successful connection test.
alt: Console 企业翻译服务与凭据配置页面
Console organization translation services and credential configuration

title: 翻译与 AI 助手，分别选择服务
Choose translation and assistant services separately
description: 初始企业管理员在「AI 与翻译服务」中选择助手模型，可与阅读翻译使用不同服务。启用后，授权会话的近期文本、标签、内部备注和本次草稿会发送给所选模型。

The initial administrator selects an assistant model in AI and translation services, independently of reading translation. Once enabled, recent authorized messages, tags, internal notes and the current draft are sent to that model.
alt: Console 分别选择默认翻译服务与 AI 助手模型
Console separate selectors for the default translation service and AI assistant model

name: DuduAdmin
title: 管理企业开通与平台运营。
Manage organization provisioning and platform operations.
lead: 面向平台管理员，维护企业及其资源，查看运营概览和操作记录。企业内部员工与渠道配置由企业控制台负责。
For platform administrators provisioning organizations, managing resources and reviewing operational summaries and activity logs. Organization staff and channels are managed in Console.
features: 企业开通
Organization provisioning
开通企业并设置初始企业管理员，为企业建立使用入口。
Provision organizations and their initial administrators.
企业管理
Organization management
查询企业资料，维护企业状态并查看企业详情。
Find organization records, manage status and inspect organization details.
资源概览
Resource overview
查看企业资源汇总与运营概览。
Review organization resource summaries and operational overviews.
操作记录
Activity records
查询管理操作记录，辅助日常核查。
Review administrative activity records for routine checks.
steps: 平台管理员登录管理后台。
Sign in as a platform administrator.
开通企业并设置初始企业管理员。
Provision an organization and set its initial administrator.
企业管理员进入 Console 配置团队，坐席进入 Desk 接待。
Organization administrators configure the team in Console; agents handle conversations in Desk.
scope: 平台管理与企业内部管理职责分离。Admin 不承担坐席接待，也不替代渠道平台的账号申请和授权流程。
Platform administration is separate from organization management. Admin does not handle agent conversations or replace channel account applications and authorization.

name: MockPulse
title: 在本地构造渠道回调，验证接入流程。
Construct channel callbacks and test integrations locally.
lead: 面向开发者的本地回调模拟工具。通过内置模板、事件素材和剧本组织协议联调；运行 DuDu 客服系统无需启动此工具。
A local callback simulator for developers. Built-in templates, saved events and scripts support protocol testing. Running the DuDu support system does not require this tool.
features: 事件编辑
Event editing
从内置渠道模板创建事件素材，按字段说明编辑回调内容。
Create event fixtures from built-in templates and edit callback fields with descriptions.
签名与加密
Signing and encryption
按已支持渠道的协议构造签名与加密报文。
Construct signatures and encrypted payloads for supported channel protocols.
剧本与编排
Scripts and orchestration
组织多个事件的执行顺序，复现接入场景。
Arrange event execution to reproduce integration scenarios.
运行记录
Run records
查看运行结果和回执，定位协议联调问题。
Review run results and receipts to investigate protocol integration issues.
steps: 配置本地接收服务的目标地址与测试参数。
Configure the target URL and test settings for your local receiving service.
选择内置模板或事件素材，编辑字段并组织剧本。
Choose a built-in template or saved event, edit fields and arrange scripts.
在桌面端执行并核对回执、签名和接收服务的处理结果。
Run in the desktop app and inspect receipts, signatures and receiving-service results.
scope: 完整本地存储、签名与发送能力依赖桌面环境。模拟通过不代表已完成真实平台授权或生产收发验证。
Full local storage, signing and sending require the desktop environment. Successful simulation does not establish platform authorization or production messaging.

name: DUDU Server
title: 连接渠道接入、权限与坐席接待。
Connect channel integrations, access control and agent workflows.
lead: DuDu 各应用共用的服务端，负责认证、企业与用户组权限、渠道消息处理、会话存储和实时更新。
The shared server for DuDu applications, handling authentication, organization and group access, channel messages, conversation storage and real-time updates.
features: 认证与权限
Authentication and access
校验用户身份，按企业和用户组控制数据访问范围。
Verify user identity and scope data access by organization and group.
渠道接入
Channel integrations
处理已支持渠道的回调验证、消息解析与指定收发能力。
Handle callback verification, message parsing and supported messaging for implemented channels.
会话与资料
Conversations and profiles
持久化来访资料、会话和消息，为各客户端提供一致数据。
Store visitor details, conversations and messages for consistent client access.
实时更新
Real-time updates
通过实时通知向工作台提供来信和接待范围变化。
Notify workspaces of incoming messages and conversation-access changes.
steps: 部署数据库与服务端，完成环境配置。
Deploy the database and server, then configure the environment.
运行管理端与工作台，建立企业、团队和渠道账号。
Run the administration apps and workspace, then create organizations, teams and channel accounts.
配置公开回调地址，在平台授权后验证实际收发。
Configure public callback URLs and validate messaging after platform authorization.
scope: 服务端不是独立的客服界面，需要配合管理端与工作台使用。生产部署须替换开发凭据、配置公开地址并完成渠道验证。

The server is not an independent support interface; use it with the administration apps and workspace. Production deployment requires replacing development credentials, configuring public URLs and validating channels.
